title: Density Formula
text: Density is mass per unit volume: $$\rho=\frac{m}{V}, $$ where $$\rho$$ is the density, $$m$$ is the mass, and $$V$$ is the volume occupied by the substance.

title: Factor of Density Increase Formula
text: The factor of density increase is $$\frac{\rho_{f}}{\rho_{i}}=\frac{m/V_{f}}{m/V_{i}}=\frac{V_{i}}{V_{f}},$$ where $$\rho_{f}$$ is the final density and $$\rho_{i}$$ is the initial density.
